text: 奥精医疗(688613.SH)公告称，公司于2026年11月1日收到证监会《立案告知书》，因涉嫌定期报告等财务数据虚假记载，证监会决定对公司立案。若后续经行政处罚认定触及重大违法强制退市情形，公司股票将被实施重大违法强制退市。目前公司经营管理正常，将积极配合调查并履行信息披露义务。
text_en: Allgens Medical (688613.SH) announced that on November 1, 2026, it received a Notice of Case Filing from the CSRC. Because it is suspected of false records in financial data such as periodic reports, the CSRC has decided to open a case against the company. If administrative penalties later determine that the circumstances trigger mandatory delisting for major violations, the company's shares will be subject to mandatory delisting for major violations. The company's operations and management are currently normal, and it will actively cooperate with the investigation and fulfill its information disclosure obligations.
